text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I got plenty of rest yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Rest days are super important to encourage supercompensation in your muscles, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Taking 24 to 48 hours of rest enhances muscle strength and makes a noticeable difference in your next performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Though it's not just about resting; by rotating which muscle groups you train each day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what am I rambling on about to you, Trainer...!
I'm sorry, you surely knew all this already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway,
now I can train with everything I've got again!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Give me some intense coaching
that'll make my body scream with joy!
